description: Process collector in api/internal/collectors/process.go. Endpoint: GET /api/v1/metrics/processes. UI ProcessMonitor component with zombie detection, high-thread monitoring, memory leak candidates, and process kill dialog. Note: UI calls POST /processes/{pid}/kill but this endpoint is not implemented in the API router — kill action silently fails.

requirements.description: System must monitor and manage processes including zombie detection and process termination. Process monitoring (zombie, high-thread, leak candidates) is fully implemented. Process kill is not: UI has kill confirmation dialog but POST /processes/{pid}/kill endpoint is missing from the API router.
requirements.title: Process Monitoring

title: Process monitoring and management (zombie detection, process kill)
